text: Anne P: Quick design review — new Compliance settings screen (screenshot attached). Two quick areas I'm worried about: region selection ordering and the little KMS badge copy/contrast. Also getting a11y eyes on the retention tooltip. Mike D: Saw the mock, looks good overall. For region dropdown: can we order by 'recently used' > 'home region' > alphabetical? Right now it's alphabetical which buries the common choice. :thinking_face: Tara (DevEx): Agree on ordering. Also keyboard users hit the dropdown then the inline 'KMS' badge is not reachable via tab (trapped on the caret). Could we make the badge a focusable button with clear aria-label? e.g. ```html ``` That lets screen readers open the modal. Anne P: Nice. For copy: we currently show "KMS" as a badge with tooltip text "Customer key (KMS)". Options: A) "Customer-managed key (KMS)" B) "External key (KMS)" C) "Customer KMS". Which reads best in a compact badge? I think A but length might overflow. Mike D: Vote A for clarity. If overflow is a problem we can use a condensed label on the badge and full text in tooltip: badge -> "KMS" tooltip -> "Customer-managed key (KMS) — used to encrypt retention and logs". Jess L: On retention microcopy: the current inline line says "Retention: 30 days" — users confuse what exactly is retained. Proposed tooltip copy: "Retention: 30 days — deletes request logs (prompts, metadata). Model outputs and user-supplied files excluded unless enabled." Thoughts? Raj S: +1 to clarifying what is in-scope. Also audit log wording: when someone flips KMS we write "KMS updated". Suggest more actionable phrasing: "Encryption key configuration changed by " and for key rotations: "KMS key rotated by (old key: redacted)". Mike D: A11y nit for badges: contrast fails WCAG AA at small sizes. Increase border and background contrast or include a left icon with hidden text. Also ensure focus ring meets 3:1 ratio. design-bot: any automated findings? design-bot: Accessibility scan: 1) KMS badge text contrast ratio 2.9:1 (fail for 12px). 2) Tooltip uses low-contrast gray on white (2.7:1). 3) Region dropdown hit area < 44px recommended for touch. See /reports/accessibility/1803456789. Tara (DevEx): Thanks design-bot. For tooltips, let's change color token to "text-800" and add 12px min font-size for tooltips. For KMS badge: propose visible label + hidden sr-only expanded copy for screenreaders: ```html KMS — customer-managed encryption key enabled ``` That plus proper focusable element should satisfy. Anne P: Good. One more layout question: should region selector live above retention (current) or closer to "Deployment & keys" section? Product concern: region affects routing/cost whereas retention is data lifecycle. I'm leaning keep region near deployment settings so users see KMS+region together. Mike D: UX leaning same — group by "Where data is stored & encrypted" section with region + KMS badge + link to key management. That reduces scanning cost. Jess L: Quick copy tweak for audit log entries: use present tense and include object: example: "Updated retention policy: 30 days (request logs) — changed by Jess L". Keeps logs searchable. Raj S: Also add machine-readable tags to logs: `action:retention_update`, `target:retention_days`, `method:ui`. That will help downstream analytics. (noting to infra) Anne P: Perfect. Action items: Mike — update mock to show grouping and badge focusable; Tara — update a11y checklist and tooltip tokens; Raj — propose audit log canonical phrases; Jess — final copy strings for tooltips. I'll gather and schedule a short follow-up review tomorrow. :thumbsup: Mike D: On it. I'll push a quick figma snapshot to the thread in ~30m. :rocket: design-bot: Note: new snapshot uploaded (figma://file/abc123). Automated contrast check will re-run on new snapshot.
